flows.title: Verify Primary Navigation and User Actions

criteria.title: Home Button Redirects to Main Page
criteria.given: User is on the main interface

criteria.title: Search Bar Filters Products
criteria.given: User is on the product listing page
criteria.when: User types 'laptop' in the search bar
criteria.then: Product list updates to show only items matching 'laptop'

criteria.title: Product Grid Displays Correctly
criteria.when: User inspects the product grid section
criteria.then: Grid contains at least 12 items with consistent spacing and alignment

criteria.title: Product Card Hover Shows Details
criteria.given: User hovers over a product card
criteria.then: Card displays price and rating information

criteria.title: Scrolling Loads Infinite Content
criteria.given: User scrolls to the bottom of the product list
criteria.when: User continues scrolling beyond 100% of the viewport
criteria.then: New products load dynamically into the grid
